prerequisites: Prior knowledge of information transfer and processing
Prior knowledge of general physics including mechanics, electricity and magnetism

learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to analyze networks with resistors, capacitors, coils, diodes, transistors and opamps in DC, frequency domain and time domain.
The student is able to create small-signal equivalent models for transistors and diodes.
The student is able to analyze networks with resistors, capacitors, coils, diodes, transistors and opamps for small signals.
The student understands the difference between a DC, AC and TRAN network analysis in a simulator and can apply this to an example.
The student understands the difference between noise and distortion as limitations of analog circuits and can apply this knowledge in the analysis of an analog circuit.
The student is able to analyze more complex analog circuits, with opamps and transistors, in DC, frequency domain and time domain.
The student is able to analyze RF amplifiers.

syllabus_topics: Electrical components and DC network analysis
Network analysis in the time domain, in the frequency domain and the Bode plot
The diode: circuits with diodes and small-signal model

Transistor circuits and opamp structures (diff pair, cascode, current mirror, 
)
Transistor circuits and opamp structures (basic OTA, cascode OTA, folded cascode OTA)
Simulation of amplifier circuit in LTspice (compulsory)
Realization of a PCB via e-FAB and measurement of this amplifier circuit (Lab, compulsory)
assessment_rules: The final score is composed of 20% from the practicum report and presentation, and 80% from the oral exam during the examination period. If the evaluation shows that the student has insufficiently achieved one or more objectives of the course, the overall result may differ from the weighted average of the components. Resit is only possible for the oral exam; the practicum score is fully carried over for the resit.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
